name: LENS
summary: LENS developed an indium-loaded scintillator concept for real-time spectroscopy of low-energy solar electron neutrinos. Its segmented optical lattice and delayed coincidence tag were also studied for artificial-source sterile-neutrino searches. The reviewed sources document detector R&D and proposed full-scale operation.
physics_targets: Solar pp, beryllium-7 and CNO neutrinos
detection_principle: Electron-neutrino capture on indium-115 produces an electron and a delayed gamma cascade from an excited tin-115 state. A three-dimensional scintillation lattice localizes the prompt and delayed deposits to suppress accidental backgrounds.

status.label: Historical R&D / full-scale operation unverified
status.evidence: The FY2014 institutional report lists LENS as an R&D programme at KURF. A full-scale solar-neutrino detector operating in 2026 was not verified.
